meaning:
1) name
1a) name
1b) reputation, fame, glory
1c) the Name (as designation of God)
1d) memorial, monument
Aramaic equivalent: shum (שֻׁם "name" H8036)

renderings.kjv: Therefore is the name of it
and all of them by their names
and he shall have no name
That which hath been is named
And it shall be to me a name
and it shall be to them a renown
that no more of thy name
